paragraphs: CemSites sells software to cemetery organizations, with a stated mission of bringing the time and money-saving benefits of modern technology to every cemetery organization. The company also offers a product for funeral homes.

Cemeteries keep their current naming and numbering conventions, formatting, and layouts while choosing the tools they need. Records are moved to protected servers that the company says are backed up daily. Staff then reach live data remotely from any device. Roles are defined by the customer so that the grounds crew, management, and board members each have their own view. Other pieces named on the site include drone mapping and flyovers. Families can also purchase graves online.
Customers get proactive checkups and a dedicated client support advocate around the clock, according to the company. The company tells buyers that their investment stays in the USA.
